the_rate_and_what_it_implies.this_wave_projection: two eligible clips left, e05 and e07, so about +0.0024 of entry AUC -- short of the +0.0066 that passes wte09fl. On the evidence this wave probably does not buy a rank point, and I would rather say so now than after the fact.

my_eligibility_test_also_failed: I argued only clips with LOOSE shipped MPPE can adopt, since the rule forbids MPPE regressions. That is still true as a necessary condition -- both tight clips, e13 and e14, were refused on exactly that -- but it is weak as a sufficient one: of five loose clips tried, only two adopted (e19, e28), while e25, e01 and e04 all had room and failed. So the criterion narrows the field from 13 to 3 without raising the hit rate inside it.
what_is_now_four_refuted_selection_ideas: loose shipped MPPE as a sufficient condition
the_standing_recommendation_unchanged_bu: Run the arm broadly and do not select, because nothing predicts it. At +0.0012 of entry AUC per $0.50 clip, the ten structurally ineligible clips are not worth buying, and the honest expected value of the whole remaining population is small. The arm's real contribution today was e28 alone: +0.2086 of AUC and MPPE 44.07 -> 9.58, which carried the SP-SR board and the MPPE rank point by itself.
